author: AlexanderKalistratov
title: NPU Models Tests fail downloading TF Hub Kaggle models due to DNS resolution failure

failed_jobs.name: NPU Models Tests / 6010
failed_jobs.symptom: TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (convert_model) step failed: 2 of 2 kaggle.com-hosted TF Hub model downloads raised URLError getaddrinfo failed

root_cause: The 'TensorFlow Models Tests - NPU compile-only (convert_model)' step tried to download two Kaggle-hosted TF Hub models (google/resnet-v2 and google/mobilenet-v2 feature-vector variants) via tensorflow_hub.load(). Both downloads failed with a Windows socket error 11001 (WSANO_DATA / getaddrinfo failed), indicating the Windows runner could not resolve the kaggle.com/www.kaggle.com hostname at that moment - a transient DNS/network outage on the self-hosted Windows runner, not caused by the PR under test (src/plugins/intel_npu NPUW LongRoPE pattern change, unrelated to TF Hub/Kaggle downloads). This exact failure signature has recurred twice before (2026-09-28, 2026-11-14) on different PRs with different kaggle/TF Hub models, confirming it is an environment-level network flake rather than a code regression.
reproduction_steps: Not reliably reproducible locally; requires hitting the same Windows self-hosted runner during a DNS outage. To approximate: run `python -m pytest install/tests/model_hub_tests/tensorflow/test_tf_convert_model.py -k NPU` on a Windows runner while www.kaggle.com is unreachable, or simulate with a hosts-file block on kaggle.com.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed 'NPU Models Tests / 6010' job - this is a transient DNS/network issue unrelated to the PR changes.
If recurrence continues, consider adding retry-with-backoff around tensorflow_hub.load()/urllib calls in models_hub_common/multiprocessing_utils.py for TF Hub/Kaggle model downloads.
Monitor whether this correlates with a specific self-hosted Windows runner pool (aks-win-4-cores-8gb-test) having intermittent DNS resolver issues.
prevention_strategies: Add bounded retries (e.g. 3 attempts with exponential backoff) around external model-hub downloads in model_hub_tests test infrastructure, and/or mark DNS/getaddrinfo failures from third-party model hosts as auto-retriable in CI so a single DNS blip does not block the merge queue.
historical_context: Same signature (urlopen error errno 11001 getaddrinfo failed, Network category) previously seen on PR #38762 (2026-11-14, run 43558800317) and PR #38400 (2026-09-28, run 36375932375), and a closely related EasyOCR-detector-model variant on PR #38219 (2026-09-18). All resolved by re-running; none required a code fix. This makes the current occurrence the pattern's 3rd/4th hit (now count=3 in the persistent pattern record).
